overview: The School Committee received reports on after-school enrollment, vocational high school programs, and the FY26 budget calendar. Members also approved using construction management at risk for middle school HVAC projects and directed the administration to present a supplemental budget following the passage of ballot questions 7 and 8.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss union negotiations and superintendent contract strategy before resuming public session.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on digitized historical yearbooks, the counseling department's new assistance dog, upcoming drama club performances, and safe gun storage communication.

items.title: After School Report
items.summary: Director of Family and Community Engagement Megan Fidler-Carey reviewed waitlist numbers, outside provider partnerships, and transportation hurdles preventing program expansion to the Andrews Middle School.

items.title: CTE Enrollment Report
items.summary: Medford Vocational Technical High School Principal Chad Fallon reported on growing enrollment, ongoing waitlists, staffing shortages in vocational fields, and student co-op successes.

items.title: Draft FY26 Budget Calendar
items.summary: Budget analyst Gerry McCue proposed shifting initial FY26 budget development into February and adoption hearings into March, prompting discussion on alignment with the city's budget ordinance and capital planning.

items.title: Construction Management at Risk Authorization
items.summary: Approved authorizing the use of construction management at risk services and execution of contracts for the McGlynn and Andrews HVAC upgrade projects.

items.title: Supplemental Budget and Staffing Impact Report
items.summary: Approved a consolidated resolution requesting the administration present a proposed supplemental budget and position impact report on January 13, 2025, to allocate funds approved under ballot questions 7 and 8.

items.title: Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee Appointment
items.summary: Approved appointing Director of Communications Will Pipicelli as a non-voting member of the High School Building Committee, replacing Thomas Dalton.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Offered condolences to the families of Maureen L. Kidney and Laurel Schumann.
